breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0 on all edges) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits the contradictory periodic condition and only states 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all four edges.', thus fixing the inconsistency.
